title: The End of Oak Street
plot_overview: After a mysterious cosmic event tears an ordinary suburban neighborhood from its familiar surroundings, a family finds itself in an unknown and increasingly dangerous place. With the landscape transformed and prehistoric dangers nearby, they must stick together and navigate the strange new world in hopes of surviving.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you’re after a fast-moving adventure with dinosaurs, suburban chaos, and family dynamics; Not for you if you want a fresh premise or deeply developed characters.
review_summary: Pros: entertaining dinosaur action; lively adventure; fun premise | Cons: generic family drama; familiar influences; uneven emotional moments
